description: Replace this young tree with a tiny newly sprouted seedling that is about one third as tall and one third as wide: a single slender stem carrying two small rounded leaves, and at its base only a narrow little root collar with two or three short thin rootlets - NOT the wide spreading root flare of a grown tree. Keep the identical art style, the same warm brown bark, the same sage-green leaf colour, the same soft brown outline and the same low camera angle, on a transparent background with no soil, no grass, no ground and no shadow.
